runs.question: Which module implements the semantic index, and which one stores memory across sessions?
runs.answer: The semantic index is implemented in vulcan/rag.py and memory across sessions is stored in vulcan/memory.py:1-31

runs.question: Which module talks to the LLM, and which one defines the sandboxed tools?
runs.answer: The module that talks to the LLM is vulcan/llm.py. The module that defines the sandboxed tools is vulcan/tools.py.

runs.question: Where is the ReAct loop implemented, and which environment variable selects the model?
runs.answer: The ReAct loop is implemented in vulcan/agent.py. The environment variable that selects the model is VULCAN_MODEL, as specified in README.md:line 51.

runs.question: Which module holds runtime configuration, and which one measures throughput?
runs.answer: Runtime configuration is held in the serving configuration (e.g., concurrency, max-num-seqs) as defined in the vLLM serving setup. Throughput is measured in chunks per second (e.g., 162.5 chunks/s at 8 concurrent) and TTFT (Time to First Token, e.g., 1.629s at 8 concurrent), as detailed in docs/spec.md and docs/deck.md:301-360 and docs/deck.md:51-110.

runs.question: Which module implements the semantic index, and which one stores memory across sessions?
runs.answer: The semantic index is implemented in vulcan/rag.py (class Index), and memory across sessions is stored in vulcan/memory.py.

runs.question: Which module talks to the LLM, and which one defines the sandboxed tools?
runs.answer: The module that talks to the LLM is vulcan/llm.py. The module that defines the sandboxed tools is vulcan/tools.py. (cite files: README.md:51-110, vulcan/llm.py:1-60, vulcan/tools.py:1-60)

runs.question: Where is the ReAct loop implemented, and which environment variable selects the model?
runs.answer: The ReAct loop is implemented in vulcan/agent.py. The environment variable that selects the model is VULCAN_MODEL, as specified in README.md:51-110.

runs.question: Which module holds runtime configuration, and which one measures throughput?
runs.answer: Runtime configuration is held in scripts/serving-sweep.sh, and throughput is measured in docs/spec.md and docs/deck.md, with metrics like chunks per second (chunks/s) and TTFT (Time To First Token).
